notes.title: Game update and special 20% OFF sale!
notes.notes:
Good news, Adepts of Alchemical Arts!

Alchemist Shop Simulator has just received an update introducing a lot of quality-of-live improvements and fixes. You can check the entire changelog for ver. 1.03 below, but before that let please give us a moment to thank all the players who have contacted us here on Steam, or via our Discord, to tell us what they think about the game and their ideas on how to improve it. We appreciate so many of you taking their time to reach out to us! You're the best.

We're happy to see so many of you enjoying our first retail sim game! Please consider letting the other Steam Players that you like it via the awesome power granted to you by Steam - that is, by leaving a review :) This is the best way to help us with sales and ensure the continued development on the game. Or should we say... games? Scroll down below the changelog to find out what we mean!

Special promo - save 20% on Alchemist Shop Simulator!

Yes, we do have a special discount to go with the update! Until 2nd June, 10am PST you can get the game with 20% discount, which brings the price just under $10 for the very first time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3043310/Alchemist_Shop_Simulator/

Full 1.03 Cahngelog:
Changes:
 In cursor mode (accessible via [TAB], a button was added that allows you to teleport to the shop (by a teleportation rune the player now carries).
 Plant labels are now smaller, so they don’t obscure other labels as much.
 Customers now pay slightly smaller amounts, resulting in less change being returned.
 It’s now possible to sell shelves and flowerpots. Just aim at them and press R to open a popup. If a pot contains a plant or a piece of furniture holds items, it cannot be sold—a popup explains why. These items sell for half their original value.
 Going to sleep now progresses the growth/wilting of plants. It’s a fairly complex system that also takes into account upgrades (such as the cloud that waters plants).
 A vertical scrollbar has been added to the skills screen, allowing navigation on wider screen resolutions. All resolutions should be playable now - if there's still any trouble, please let us know!
 Pressing ESC while using the alchemy table no longer opens the pause menu, but instead causes the player to stop using the table.


Bug Fixes:
 It’s no longer possible to take an item out of a chest when its quantity is set to 0. (sorry folks!)
 Fixed a bug where it was possible to spend 2 skill points on the same skill by clicking the button before the animation finished. This should prevent players from being able to complete the skill tree.
 Fixed a bug that caused the mailbox icon to not always appear when a new letter arrived.


Pirate Cove Simulator - play the demo of our next game!
[previewyoutube=GAnbiFXDdA8;full][/previewyoutube]

There you have it, matey. The long-awaited demo to the second of our retail sims is now out for every landlubber and salty dog to try out for themselves. The game shares some ideas of the Alchemist Shop Simulator, but comes with a lot of original takes and new mechanics, so make sure to check the demo out. And while you're there - don't forget to hit those wishlist and follow buttons, so we can keep you in the loop in the (short) time leading to the game's full release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290660/Pirate_Cove_Simulator/

This is it for today, from your friends at Kool2Play. Stir your cauldrons well, Adepts!
Best wishes,
Kool2Play Team

notes.title: Release Date & Next Fest Demo update!
notes.notes:
Scholars!
We're happy to announce that the development of our magical and cozy retail management sim, Alchemist Shop Simulator, has come to a conclusion and there's only a bit over 2 weeks of wait before the FULL release (that's right - no Early Access).

[previewyoutube=E77s6jI1Wdk;full][/previewyoutube]

We aimed to expand and improve on the popular concept of shop management games by giving it some more immersive mechanics (like potion brewing, gardening, little story-quests) and a vibrant, funny, fantastical world. We'd love to hear from you - did we succeed?

For the last several months lots of Steam players tried the demo (currently enjoying 100% positive rating!) and provided us with feedback. Some content creators who already got their hands on on the full game preview copies have been in touch with us as well. Thanks to all the amazing people who played the game and took their time to give us their thoughts we've been able to improve on the initial state of the game immensely. We'll be launching a far superior game to what we originally had in mind - all thanks to the wonderful community of Steam players. 

This also called for...

Next Fest Demo update!

The Alchemist Shop Simulator Demo has undergone an extensive revamp as well. What everyone will play now, at Steam Next Fest is fully representative of the current state of the full game, so you can have a real taste of the alchemist's world and life in magical retail. Just mind the fact that the demo will be going away soon after the Next Fest ends (but probably not immediately).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3043310/Alchemist_Shop_Simulator/

Please enjoy the demo and remember to wishlist the full game, so we can remind you when it launches. This will additionally benefit you because we do plan to run a release-week discount for the game (which will be regularly priced at $11.99). 

More retail sims incoming!

Upon completion of our Alchemist Shop Simulator, Kool2Play now puts its focus on its tropical follow up - Pirate Cove Simulator. No worries - this doesn't mean we're not planning on updating Alchemist Shop Simulator. On the contrary - we look forward to all the post-release feedback, as it will give us opportunity to improve and expand BOTH of the games.

Pirate Cove Simulator  will be getting its own demo soon - no later than April - when we're satisfied that it includes everything we've learned during and soon after the launch of its predecessor.

If you do enjoy retail sims, and would like to take a shot at breaking the curse of the Island of the Damned, and trading your way out of the pirate afterlife - you can already wishlist Pirate Cove Simulator:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290660/Pirate_Cove_Simulator/

That's it from us today! We hope you'll enjoy the Alchemist Shop Simulator demo and join us for its FULL LAUNCH on March 11. 

Get brewing!

Yours,
Kool2Play Team

notes.title: BIG Demo update!
notes.notes:
Adepts of the arcane arts!

When we first released our demo, Alchemist Shop Simulator was still early in the development. Now, as the game is more or less done, and we're focusing on giving it some final polishing touches, we couldn't bare the thought that the demo players are experiencing an outdated version of our game. Time to change this! Today, we're rolling out Demo v. 1.0.1, with all the bells and whistles of the full game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074735/77a833f119384f962eeca87d09e2df2d839c8a78.jpg

Release notes for Demo v. 1.0.1:

 There's a save and load function now, along with three save-slots to have more than one game going at once
 The town came to life with NPCs going about their business or just idling like... well... like NPCs
 A lot of Quality-of-Life improvements were introduced to the game, like pinning potion recipes in the grimoire so that they will levitate above the alchemy station, quick search bar for items in storages and store, and many others
 Display with aspect ratios other than 16:9 are now better supported
 The missing Korean localization was added
 A settings menu was added
 Lots of bugs were fixed

But don't just read about it - please, try it for yourself! And do remember to wishlist the full game if you enjoy the demo. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3114000/Alchemist_Shop_Simulator_Demo/

On that note, if you do like your experience with our demo, it would mean a lot to our team, if you share a review of the demo (yes, you can now review demos!) with the rest of the Steam community. 

That's it for today. May your cauldron never leak!

Kool2Play Team

notes.title: Demo update #1
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Alchemist Shop Simulator Demo!

Great to hear from you! Your feedback has been really helpful. We're happy to roll-out the first update to our Demo. Here's what's changed:

 Merchant delivers the goods on hourly basis - no more long wait times
 Better resolution support for some less popular ones (16:10 and others) 
 Minor fixes to the tutorial flow
 Time now stops when you read letters, recipes, and various pop-ups
 Typo and UI glitch minor fixes

Thank you for keeping in touch. We'll keep the improvements coming :-)

Best wishes,
The Kool2Play Team

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hello, Alchemy Adepts!

Just in time for Wholesome Games Celebration, we've just launched the demo of our Alchemist Shop Simulator on Steam, and we're really excited to see people trying out our game. With this title, we're sticking to the traditional release scheme - no Early Access is planned. Instead - we're looking now at couple of months of additional polish before we announce the release date.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074735/8374b8c56fbb311a688de9c230a37386a2d97e17.gif

For that reason, all player feedback is extremely valuable to our little team. We're testing the game ourselves, of course, and we'll be working with external QA team before the release. This is not about asking you to help us ship to get rid of the bugs for free (although, bug reports are always welcome, too!). It's about getting your insight on the game.

Please comment on this forum thread with all your feedback:

 what do you like
 what dou you hate
 what you feel is missing
 what needs more love

... and anything else you feel like telling us. Or if you want to take a more direct approach, and come and meet us - why not join our DISCORD?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3043310/Alchemist_Shop_Simulator/

Thanks so much, and we hope you enjoy our game!
The Kool2Play Team

PS. If you like what you see here, please make sure to wishlist the game! It makes ALL THE DIFFERENCE for a small indie studio like Kool2Play, and this is the best way you can support us.
